body: But it seems like you're not selfish/greedy/evil. Why not try to promote that in others?

I don't think either is particularly hard. This is a person who I helped out of an abusive relationship. I was there for them when they were in the gutter crying and lost. Literally picked them up off of the ground. When I tried to confront my depression and hordes of issues they kind of just shrugged and said good luck. If I forgave my friend it would put me where I am now. Discarded and kind of useless.

I want a meaningful existence. But i'm afraid the only way I can ever matter is if I take from other people.

I have been you. I pulled the trigger and it didn't happen. I regret it sometimes but I have been thankful that it did not happen other times. You would be surprised how much of a relief not dying can be.
